plan.title: Convert to Auction available during RFQ evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation; this must be the first step for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for this tenant.
Navigate from the summary to the RFQ stage page where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Assert that Convert to Auction is offered and clickable for the RFQ in evaluation.
Open the conversion window without confirming the conversion.
Assert that selecting Convert to Auction opens a dialog or conversion window.
Cancel the conversion so the event is not changed.
Assert that the conversion window closed after cancellation.
